name = "pitzDaily"
dim = 2            # one cell thick, empty front and back
formal_order = 2
refined = "mesh"
grid_sequence = "structured"

[[levels]]
name = "139k"
path = "n139k"

[[levels]]
name = "62k"

# 10% of the samples.
